definitions.K11_vs_paper_K14: K11 = paper K14 minus ['logreg_all_kv', 'gbm_all_kv', 'logreg_colour_kv'] (not in the Kaggle rescore files)
definitions.agreement: Spearman (Pearson on average ranks) of per-method mean scores between two datasets over a method set

summaries.wound vs other: mean of the 28 pairs of a wound reference with a non-wound reference (stats_v7 comp|wound|in x out)
summaries.colonoscopy vs other: mean of the 30 pairs of a colonoscopy reference with a non-colonoscopy reference
summaries.modality_diff: mean of the 16 same-modality pairs minus mean of the 39 across-modality pairs (11 references)

definitions.stratified: methods ranked within each group, percentiles (rank - 0.5) / n_group, Pearson correlation of the pooled percentiles (stats_v7 section 7 pearson_on_percentiles)
definitions.size_weighted_within: sum over groups of n_group times the group's agreement matrix, divided by N
definitions.method_bootstrap: stats_v5 design (stats_v7.v5_method_takes): per draw methods resampled with replacement within each group, groups in set order, default_rng(0) per set, B 2000; 95% percentile interval; same draws for every condition of a set (paired changes); within-group and stratified values from the group parts of the same draw
definitions.exact_test: all 13,860 distinct assignments of the 11 modality labels; p = share with difference >= observed (stats_v7.exact_test); smallest attainable p = 2/13,860

variants.P0: main pipeline (trained: Gaussian smoothing, threshold, small components; untrained: close, open, small components)
variants.P1: trained: threshold then 5 px close and open, small components; untrained: identical to P0 by definition
variants.P2: threshold (trained) or raw mask (untrained), small-component removal only

composition_criteria.C1: pooled agreement in the domain minus the higher within-group value, paired 95% interval above 0

definitions.exclusions: results/exclusions_v6.json by image index; fuseg_r256 uses the fuseg exclusions

engine_vs_stats_v7_run1.what: run-1 scores via perimage_v7.load; point summaries and method-only B 2000 intervals vs stats_v7.json bootstrap[...]['method_only_repro_B2000'] (keys wound pairs, comp|wound|in x out, colonoscopy pairs, comp|colonoscopy|in x out, modality_diff, same modality (16 pairs), across modality, fuseg~azh, same dataset); exact p and difference vs stats_v7.json exact[...]['full_55']; stratified pearson_on_percentiles and size_weighted_average for U+F, U+M19, U+K

M19_K11_vs_robust_v7.what: M19 and K11 computed here vs results/v7/robust_v7.json: post-processing summaries and changes, tolerance summaries and changes vs nsd2, resolution summaries and change
